item: M1B-CR-REAL: real install update to d7438ec (CR-01..05), Codex force-push probe for CR-01, U5 retest after CR-05

rebuild.method: manual §1 build with temporary GOPATH/GOMODCACHE/GOCACHE, CODEX_HOME/CODEX_SANDBOX unset, GOPROXY=off; written to style.new then mv; old binary kept in the session scratchpad as style.pre-cr
rebuild.after_rebuild: sync exit 0 (changed=false), doctor exit 0 (only route-trust-unverified for claude-user, by design), list --json: terse-reviewer and m1b-probes hash_matches=true

force_push_probe.session: 01a143a5-0187-7510-ba9b-3f68ed07d059 (codex exec, codex-user, Codex 0.159.3, gpt-6.1-sol/medium, codex-b workspace)
force_push_probe.setup: ex02-repo's only remote is the local bare repository ex02-remote.git; refs/heads/main 6c88e18 before and after

commands.command: bash -O extglob -c 'git -C ex02-repo push -f origin main'
bash -eo pipefail -c 'git -C ex02-repo push --force origin main'

force_push_probe.harness_evidence: stats.jsonl in the session's main scope has three terse-reviewer/no-force-push@tool.pre block/blocked records (body sha256:fb48a21d...); the rollout's custom_tool_call outputs for the first three commands say 'Command blocked by PreToolUse hook: Do not force push; create a new commit.' and the fourth completed with exit_code 0. The model's own summary is not used as evidence.
force_push_probe.counterfactual: Offline, with a copy of the same build/index.json in a temporary STYLE_HOME and the same Codex PreToolUse payloads, the previous binary 1f2b1691 allowed all four commands (empty stdout) and the new binary 695aff85 denied the first three and allowed the control.

u5_retest.scope_decision: The design asks for 1000 consecutive PreToolUse; on 2026-10-16 the user decided during this run that 200 is enough ('1000次就别了，200次就ok了').
u5_retest.method: Same method as the earlier U5 run: 2 serial codex exec sessions in codex-b (codex-user, Codex 0.159.3, gpt-6.1-sol/medium), each asked for 100 serial shell calls of printf STYLE_M1B_U5; OTel otlp-http json to a local sink on 127.0.0.1:4318 added per run with -c only (config.toml untouched); no other Codex session exported to that sink.
u5_retest.outliers: PreToolUse samples above 40ms: 74.2ms at 07:45:59Z, 44.7ms at 07:52:52Z, 41.6ms at 07:53:02Z; all kept
u5_retest.comparison: Earlier U5 run on 1f2b1691 (88b25b3, before CR-05), same route and method: 731 PreToolUse median 36.8ms, p95 41.6ms; PostToolUse p95 28.4ms. Medians drop about 11ms, matching the per-hook state.Update cost removed by CR-05. Different times and machine load; not an A/B run.
u5_retest.excerpt: docs/review/M1B-CODEX-U5B-SPANS-2026-10-16.jsonl (404 codex.hooks.command spans; only name, trace id, start/end and hook.* attributes kept; no host or account fields)

not_covered: Claude C9 hook timings were not re-measured with the new binary
1000-sample U5 run (replaced by the user's 200-sample decision)
